gc_policy.fingerprint_scope: measurement audits and complete saved-validation replay
gc_policy.name: natural_automatic
gc_policy.timing: retain all natural collections; lightweight observer overhead present

protocol.cohort: complete source-report validation cohort in saved selected-row order
protocol.online_boundary: serial sampling + gather + transfer + encoders + GNN + readout
protocol.seed_scheme: seed + batch-size position * 1000000 + batch_index * repeats + repeat
protocol.stage_timing: separate synchronized replay; not added to online latency
protocol.warmup_seed: reset torch RNG to the query-batch sampling seed before warmups

collection_program_window.observed_case_gc_scope: Event durations cover profile_batch_gc case windows only; natural GC during loader creation, reporting, summaries and gaps is in program wall but is not event-timed
collection_program_window.scope: This attempt after setup, source/resume audits and saved-validation replay; includes collection, warmups, audits, separate stage replays, progress reporting and monitor teardown; excludes final summary serialization

excluded_from_online_timing: correctness audits, RNG seeding, reporting and telemetry setup

host_memory.scope: process lifetime, including imports and one-time graph preparation

latency_scope: whole online pipeline with lightweight GC telemetry overhead present
notes: Natural automatic GC stays enabled; no forced collection or managed condition.
Acyclic fingerprints retain the exact archived sampled occurrence serialization.
All observations and outliers remain in the predefined summed-time estimator.
GC overlap is already inside online timings; never add it again.
Case GC observations exclude reporting gaps; program wall retains that cost.
Program wall includes warmups, audits and stage replays; it is not query throughput.
Callback/timer metadata observation overhead is present; no cost is subtracted.
Graph inputs retain conditional snapshot semantics and constant/time features.
The source activity baseline predicted better; this measures fixed-model execution.
Within-session intervals do not establish session or training-seed variability.
online_boundary: serial sampling + gather + transfer + encoders + GNN + readout

limitations: Schema/footer inspection cannot establish that exported values were available at the record timestamp.
Only constants and relative record time are approved; every candidate raw attribute remains excluded.
Historical foreign-key updates, entity merges, record deletions, and export survivorship have not been reconstructed.
Record-time visibility and per-query occurrence ownership must still pass the actual sampled-batch audit.
No preprocessing is fitted here. Any future learned preprocessing must be fitted on training-period data only.
This policy does not establish training readiness or predictive quality.
